newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY MOSTLY WEAKER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY MOSTLY WEAKER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed easier against most hard currencies on Thursday, plagued for most of the day by slight import pressure, dealers said.
"The market was a bit short and we saw the dollar decline a little bit further," a dealer said.
Dealers said the local currency hit a 11.0400/0500 low on Thursday day before the central Reserve bank intervened to inject a few U.S. dollars into the market.
"Because of the mild importer demand we should see the dollar continue depreciating tomorrow unless the Reserve Bank comes in in a big way," one dealer predicted.
At Thursday's close, the Zimbabwe dollar was quoted at 11.0300/0400 against the U.S. dollar from Wednesday's 11.0250/0350 and was also softer on sterling at 17.9900/18.0200 compared to 17.9660/9900.
It was at 2.5000/5200 from 2.4960/5010 against South Africa's rand but was little changed at 6.5500/5600 from 6.5500/5560 versus the mark.
